This page collects the **core reading** for the workshop: **Chapters 0–13**, the long-form prose treatment of each topic. Each chapter pairs **1:1** with a lecture and a tutorial — read these as the "textbook" of the workshop.

Prerequisite appendices (R, Unix, statistics, Git, HPC…) and other reference material now live in **[Additional Resources → Workshop Reference Material](Additional_Resources.qmd)**.

::: callout-tip
**Recommended reading order for the chapters.** Read each chapter *before* working its matching tutorial. The lecture is the slide-deck summary; the chapter is the detailed prose; the tutorial is the runnable code. All three reinforce the same material at three levels of abstraction.
:::

## Looking for the appendices?

Prerequisite background (R, Unix, single-cell biology, statistics) and reference material the chapters cite into — computing fundamentals, shell scripting, Git, HPC/Talapas, databases, file formats, and a methods-section template — now live in **[Additional Resources → Workshop Reference Material](Resources_Folder/Reference_Material.html)**, alongside the Glossary, VS Code & Talapas guide, Compute Environments, and the scNotebooks crosswalk. Read what you need, when you need it.

For curated **single-cell tutorials, papers, and external references**, see [Additional Resources](Additional_Resources.qmd).
